about_the_game:
Enter a corrupt and hostile library with the task of extracting forbidden knowledge from its tomes. Triumph over the entities that linger within, as well as the battles within your own mind, in this Action-Adventure first person shooter.

This is a student project.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  • Use your gun, Repulsor gadget and environmental hazards in strategic ways to dispatch the corrupted creatures that roam the library.

  • Overcome trials of the mind in order to upgrade your tools.

  • Explore the labyrinthian library to replenish resources, and uncover the story that unfolded before your arrival.

  • Battle varying enemy types, each with their own unique dangers.

content_descriptors.notes: Includes fantasy combat with monsters. No blood or gore.
